name: Ligus 0.2.0
notes: Ligus (short for ligustica) 0.2.0 brings a calmer desktop with an Inbox for what needs you, a model picker in every chat, the system passkey sheet on macOS, one set of CLI conventions, a more reliable event store, and security fixes; upgrade every member of a workspace. See https://docs.langstroth.ai/ligus/reference/whats-new/.
